statBlock.name: Skyswimmer
statBlock.description: An airborne leviathan that hunts drakes, rocs, griffins, and other creatures above Ravnica.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The skyswimmer breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Slam attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Deal 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage on a hit. A Large or smaller creature hit must pass a DC 19 Dexterity save or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the skyswimmer, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the skyswimmer's turns. If a swallowed creature deals at least 30 damage to the skyswimmer in one turn, the skyswimmer must pass a DC 18 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure, it regurgitates that creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 ft. If the skyswimmer dies, it no longer restrains the swallowed creature. That creature can spend 15 ft. of movement to escape the corpse and emerges prone.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Deal 19 (2d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage on a hit.

statBlock.name: Soldier
statBlock.description: Ravnica's guild soldiers fight in formation. Their gear varies with the guild and assignment.

sections.Traits: Formation Tactics. While within 5 ft. of at least one ally, the soldier makes saving throws against being charmed, frightened, grappled, or restrained with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage on a hit, or 7 (1d10 + 2) if the sword is wielded with two hands.

statBlock.name: Sphinx of Judgment
statBlock.description: An Azorius gynosphinx who uses law magic to compel truth and imprison offenders.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Inscrutable. The sphinx is immune to effects that sense its emotions or read its thoughts and to divination spells it chooses to refuse. Wisdom (Insight) checks to gauge its intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.
Magic Weapons. The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Spellcasting:
The sphinx is a 9th-level Azorius wizard spellcaster. Intelligence sets its save DC to 16 and its spell attack bonus to +8. It casts these prepared spells without material components.
Cantrips (at will). Friends, Mage Hand, Message.
1st level (4 slots). Command, Ensnaring Strike, Shield.
2nd level (3 slots). Calm Emotions, Hold Person, Suggestion.
3rd level (3 slots). Clairvoyance, Counterspell, Dispel Magic.
4th level (3 slots). Banishment, Divination.
5th level (1 slot). Dominate Person.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage on a hit.
sections.Legendary actions:
The sphinx has 3 legendary actions and recovers spent actions at the start of its turn. It can take one option at a time, at the end of another creature's turn. It cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before it can use them.
Claw Attack (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Teleport (2 actions). The sphinx and its worn or carried equipment magically move up to 120 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space.
Cast a Spell (3 actions). Cast a prepared spell, spending a spell slot as normal.
sections.Lair actions:
When the sphinx is in its lair, it can choose one of these magical effects on initiative count 20, losing initiative ties. It must finish a short or long rest before it can repeat an effect. It cannot use a lair action while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before it can use one.
Reroll initiative. Every creature in the lair rerolls initiative. The sphinx can keep its existing result.
Change age. Every creature in the lair makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure it becomes 1d20 years older or younger, as the sphinx chooses. The creature cannot become younger than 1 year. Greater Restoration can restore its age.
Shift the lair in time. Move everything in the lair up to 10 years forward or backward. Only the sphinx notices immediately. Wish can return its caster and up to seven creatures the caster chooses to their normal time.
Shift planes. The sphinx transports itself and up to seven other creatures it can see in the lair to another plane. It cannot use lair actions while away. It can return to the lair as a bonus action on its turn and bring up to seven creatures with it.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 183, gives the Gynosphinx a replacement spell list. The base block and lair actions are in the 2014 Monster Manual, pp. 281–282.

statBlock.name: Sunder Shaman
statBlock.description: A Gruul giant who wears pieces of buildings as armor and turns its rage on Ravnica's growing city.

sections.Traits:
Reckless. At the start of its turn, the giant can choose to gain advantage on its melee weapon attack rolls for that turn. If it does, attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.
Siege Monster. The giant deals double damage to objects and structures.
Stone Camouflage. The giant makes Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks. If the giant has taken damage since its last turn, the first of those attacks to hit deals an extra 18 (4d8) damage.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Deal 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage on a hit.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Deal 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage on a hit. A creature hit must pass a DC 18 Strength save or fall prone.

statBlock.name: Winged Felidar
statBlock.description: A celestial cat with broad feathered wings. Winged felidars usually bond with Azorius archons.

sections.Languages: Understands Celestial and Common but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Bonding. The felidar can magically bond with a creature it can see immediately after observing it for at least 1 hour within 30 ft. The bond ends when the felidar bonds with another creature or its partner dies. They can communicate telepathically within 100 ft. The felidar can sense its partner's direction and distance while both are on the same plane. Either can take an action to experience the other's sight and hearing, losing its own sight and hearing until the start of its next turn.
Keen Hearing and Sight. The felidar makes Wisdom (Perception) checks based on hearing or sight with advantage.
Pounce. If the felidar moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hits it with Claws on the same turn, that creature must pass a DC 15 Strength save or fall prone. If the target is prone, the felidar can make one Claws attack against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage on a hit.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage on a hit.
sections.Variant rules: Use the Felidar stat block and add a flying speed of 40 ft. The winged variant is printed in the Winged Felidars sidebar.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 199, Felidar stat block and Winged Felidars sidebar.
